name: atc-skills
description: A 12-skill depth pack for ATC — the ACM SIGOPS Annual Technical Conference (formerly the USENIX Annual Technical Conference): USENIX's broad practical-systems venue, retired by USENIX after ATC '25 and continued under ACM SIGOPS; the ATC 2027 two-round HotCRP review whose first round reads the first two pages, the 72-hour author response, double-blind reviewing, the two-submissions-per-author cap, the Operational Systems Track, artifact-evaluation badges, shepherding with conditional acceptance, and ACM Open Access proceedings. Grounded in the ATC 2027 SIGOPS call (Rennes, 28 June - 1 July 2027), the ATC 2026 call, and the USENIX sunset record, re-verified on 2026-11-24.
